name: banana-slides
description: Sol.A presentations: Go backend, React frontend and Wails desktop

scripts.setup:test: go -C backend mod download && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: go -C backend vet ./... && go -C backend run ./cmd/sola-check && npm --prefix frontend run lint:strict
scripts.build: go -C backend build -o ../.runtime/bin/sola-server ./cmd/sola-server && npm --prefix frontend run build:check
